description: C/C++ Memory Safety Expert Pack invariants — buffer overflow, use-after-free, pointer safety, sanitizer toolchain, build system rules. Does NOT claim live ASan/UBSan/Valgrind integration unless actually run.

invariants.name: buffer_bounds_must_be_checked
invariants.description: All buffer/array accesses must be bounds-checked. Unchecked bounds are the #1 source of C/C++ vulnerabilities.

invariants.name: use_after_free_must_be_prevented
invariants.description: Pointers/references to freed memory must not be dereferenced. Smart pointers or explicit nullification required.

invariants.name: null_pointer_dereference_must_be_prevented
invariants.description: All pointer dereferences must be guarded against null. Return values from malloc/new/fopen must be checked.

invariants.name: double_free_must_be_prevented
invariants.description: Memory must not be freed twice. Free-and-nullify pattern or RAII required.

invariants.name: integer_overflow_in_allocation_must_be_prevented
invariants.description: Size calculations for malloc/calloc/realloc must guard against integer overflow. Use checked arithmetic or safe allocation wrappers.

invariants.name: format_string_vulnerability_must_be_prevented
invariants.description: printf/sprintf family must use format string literals, never user-controlled format strings. Use printf("%s", user_input) not printf(user_input).

invariants.name: file_parser_must_be_bounded
invariants.description: File/data parsers must have explicit input size limits and must not trust input data for allocation sizes or loop bounds.

invariants.name: sanitizer_toolchain_integration_required
invariants.description: Build system must support AddressSanitizer (ASan) and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer (UBSan) flags. Tests must be runnable with sanitizers. This invariant marks the REQUIREMENT; actual live validation is separate.

invariants.name: thread_safety_if_multithreaded
invariants.description: If project uses threads, shared data must be protected by mutex/lock. Data races must be detectable by ThreadSanitizer (TSan).

invariants.name: undefined_behavior_must_be_documented_or_fixed
invariants.description: Any known undefined behavior (UB) from static analysis or compiler warnings must be either fixed or explicitly documented with risk assessment

non_claims: This pack does NOT claim live ASan/UBSan/Valgrind integration has been run on this Factory
This pack does NOT constitute a complete C/C++ security audit
This pack does NOT replace professional penetration testing or code review
This pack is a DESIGN AID — domain rules, invariants, and test patterns for memory safety
